# Velociti

> Velociti is an AI-native enterprise engineering company headquartered in Dubai. Forward deployed engineers embed inside client teams to deploy secure AI agents across sales, support and operations, on the systems and data those teams already run. Canonical site: https://thinkvelociti.com (formerly velociti.club).

## Solutions
- [Operations Automation](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#operations): agents that reconcile ledgers, build reports and move work across ERPs, with human approval whenever a number matters. Up to 95% less manual ledger and reporting work.
- [Customer Support](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#support): voice, chat, email and WhatsApp agents that resolve L1 and L2 issues in any language and act in your systems.
- [Sales Automation](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#sales): autonomous SDRs for outbound research, inbound qualification and CRM hygiene.
- [Enterprise Knowledge](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#knowledge): a permission-aware RAG layer across Slack, Notion, Jira, SharePoint and PDFs, with citations on every answer.

## Delivery
- [Forward Deployed Engineers](https://thinkvelociti.com/engineers): a pod of a Forward Deployed Engineer and an AI Strategist. Engagements move from Velociti-led to client-owned; typically 8–14 weeks from kickoff to production.
- Deployment options: managed cloud, single-tenant, the client's VPC (AWS, Azure, GCP), or on-prem / airgapped with zero internet egress.

## Industries
Healthcare, Finance, Oil & Gas, Automotive, Pharma, Hospitality, Education: https://thinkvelociti.com/industries

## Results (published case studies)
- Healthcare: 99.2% claim pre-verification accuracy, 35% faster processing — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/clinical-claim-pre-verification
- Finance: +42% auto-loan underwriting throughput, −31% review time, 100% audit log coverage — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/auto-loan-underwriting
- Oil & Gas: −18% unplanned downtime, −15% maintenance OPEX, 94% alert accuracy — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/predictive-valve-telemetry
- Automotive: −24% QA cycle time, −12% defects — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/assembly-line-anomaly-detection

## Trust
Human-in-the-loop approvals, immutable audit logs, PII redaction, prompt-injection defence, AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Client data never trains public models. Compliance status: https://thinkvelociti.com/trust
